slides.title: Custom Code Linters Mechanics
slides.prompt: How do tools like Flake8 or Bandit detect bad coding patterns using Python's compiler tools?
options: They traverse AST nodes using NodeVisitors and check for vulnerable or banned node configurations
They run string regex matchers exclusively across raw file text lines
They execute target code inside isolated sandbox virtual machines
They inspect compiled C-level CPU instructions
slides.correctAnswer: They traverse AST nodes using NodeVisitors and check for vulnerable or banned node configurations
